集群ID。

description.en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.
The information about the nodes to be deleted.

description.zh:
要删除的计算节点ID。N的取值范围：1~100

您可以调用[DescribeCluster](~~87126~~)查询指定集群中的节点ID。
description.en:
The ID of the compute node to delete. You can specify up to 100 nodes.

You can call the [DescribeCluster](~~87126~~) operation to query the IDs of nodes in a specified cluster.

description.zh:
是否释放由E-HPC创建的节点。

默认值：true
description.en:
Specifies whether to release the nodes that are created by E-HPC.

Default value: true

description.zh:
是否直接删除节点。取值范围：

- true：是

- false：否
description.en:
Specifies whether to delete the nodes immediately. Valid values:

- true: Yes
- false: No

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
删除节点前，建议您导出节点上所有作业数据，以免因为删除节点而导致数据丢失。
descriptions.en:
## Description

To prevent data loss, you must export all job data from the nodes before you delete them.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc delete-nodes --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --release-instance true --sync false --instance Id=i-bp13p7vlcb1uihfv0000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc DeleteNodes --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --Instance.1.Id 'i-bp13p7vlcb1uihfv0000' --ReleaseInstance true --Sync false
